name: Ravenspire (held by Malakar)
lore: The Resistance's stronghold before the Great Darkness; it fell at 0 GD.

signs.text: Cut deep into a fallen lintel of the great hall, half under the vines: "WE HELD UNTIL THE LIGHT WENT OUT." Below it, smaller and newer, scratched by another hand: names, dozens of them, and a date counted from the Darkness. Something has walked through the hall since — the ash on the floor is marked with long, clawed prints.
